profiles.label: Q4_K/Q8_0 control

definitions.stream_wait: Sum of exposed per-layer acquire wall time; transfer-duration sums overlap compute.
definitions.expert_gemm: MUL_MAT_ID nodes whose weight origin is a routed expert.
definitions.sparse_attention_core: FLASH_ATTN nodes; projection, RoPE and packing remain in other.
definitions.indexer_core: Index scores, their top-k, candidate blocks and selected masks.
definitions.other_wall: Wall residual including other GPU work, CPU scheduling, carry/Engram work and startup.
definitions.other_gpu_by_named_origin_seconds: Disjoint subsets of other_gpu identified by node or immediate source names; anonymous intermediates remain in remaining. These are not full semantic phase timers.
definitions.tile_phase_seconds: Disjoint executor phase wall sums; compute includes graph launch and synchronization. The executor post-compute gap and work outside tiles are not included.
definitions.tile_nested_seconds: Diagnostics only: register is inside bind, bind is inside prepare, launch and sync are inside compute, and gpu spans overlap compute. Never add these to tile phases or stage_seconds.

profiles.caveat: CUDA profiling synchronizes operations. These diagnostic walls are not headline throughput or an unsynchronized overlap decomposition.
profiles.prefill_seconds_scope: legacy alias for launch-to-ready TTFT; startup included
profiles.prompt_clock_definition: Native sequential embedding_40_layers_head clock: all prompt sweeps, token preparation and between-sweep ownership admission through synchronized frontier logits. Initial model open/allocation, final bulk export/certification, recall and decode excluded. Early Engram prefetch can overlap initial open.
profiles.ttft_clock_definition: Host ComboProducer launch boundary through frontier READY: process startup, model open/allocation, prompt processing, final state certification and IPC included; external harness prechecks, recall and decode excluded.
profiles.overhead_definition: TTFT minus prompt interval; includes setup and post-head certification/IPC, not just process startup.
